content:
deploy-bot: PROMOTION PAUSED: release-v1.12.1-canary.1 failed publish step: artifact checksum mismatch when pushing wheel to registry. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/4599 :warning:
li: Wait, checksum mismatch? Which artifact and which checksum?
jose: The binary wheel: redwood_inference-1.12.1-py3-none-any.whl. Registry returned digest != local calc. Logs: https://registry.redwood.internal/jobs/4599/artifact-log
priya: Could be a transient upload/replication issue or a bad build. Last-green is v1.12.0. This build contains the security backport we need out today.
li: If it's a build corruption, rebuilding and re-uploading is usually fine. But change window closes in 30m. Rebuild takes ~12m + verification. Pinning to v1.12.0 would miss the security patch.
priya: Ops: do we have any ongoing registry maintenance? @ops-bot any S3/GCS near-term incidents?
ops-bot: Investigating. No maintenance scheduled. Checking object store consistency.
jose: I pulled the local wheel checksum: sha256: a1b2c3... and registry returned sha256: ff00ee... They differ by a few bytes - looks like upload truncated. Also saw 503s from registry during push in logs.
li: 503s indicate transient gateway. Could be an NLB glitch. ops-bot any load balancer retries?
ops-bot: NLB logs show transient 503 spike at 2024-09-20T10:15Z affecting registry writes in us-west-2. Retry usually succeeded but one worker might have seen a half-write.
priya: OK plan options: 1) Rebuild & push to new tag then promote (preferred if rebuild finishes before window) 2) Pin to v1.12.0 and ship a follow-up patch 3) Force re-upload the same artifact (dangerous) 4) Delay cut.
li: Given security patch severity, I'd rather rebuild and push as v1.12.1-canary.2, then run quick verification. If build fails again, fallback to pin+hotfix schedule.
jose: I'll kick off a deterministic rebuild with clean workspace: `ci build 4599 --clean --tag canary2`
deploy-bot: CI build started: #4600 (rebuild of #4599).
(10m)
deploy-bot: CI #4600: artifact upload succeeded, registry digest matches local sha256 [32mOK[0m. E2E quick-smoke started.
qa-bot: quick-smoke results: 12/12 smoke checks passed.
li: Great. Can we promote canary2? Remember to update release notes with "registry transient 503 caused initial artifact upload corruption; rebuilt artifact pushed as canary. No code changes."
priya: Also add a note to ops-runbook: monitor registry 5xx spike correlation with NLB. Filing REG-3421.
jose: Starting promote: `deploy promote release-v1.12.1-canary.2 --to canary`
deploy-bot: Promote started.
(5m)
deploy-bot: Promote complete: canary live. No rollout errors.
li: Will run end-to-end smoke for 30m then decide for full release. Change window still open for 20m.
(35m later)
li: Post-canary: all metrics look healthy, error rates normal. No rollback needed.
priya: Closing thread. Follow-ups: REG-3421 for registry spike, and a doc change to add checksum verification to the publish step (CI-567). Thanks. :tada:
